claim: The pinned AoC module can compile with cross GCC 11 without floating-point instructions or a change to its ramdump wire layout.
oracle: The actual ramdump header keeps its 44-byte section size and field offsets; the EQ coefficient transfer copies all 32 bits without floating point; the full external AoC module builds.

user_journey.scenario: A reproducible build supplies matching hardware modules before the phone is recovered and tested.
user_journey.expected: The build completes without silently dropping AoC; audio hardware and voice calls remain separately unverified.

invariants: Validate pinned input hashes before edits
Use fixed u32 storage in firmware-facing fields
gitnexus: Unavailable; directly inspect header and coefficient assignment.
ast: Compile real transformed header with static layout assertions

unit.red: GCC 11 rejects fixed underlying enum syntax and floating assignment under -mgeneral-regs-only.
unit.green: Original pinned header compiled as C++ and transformed C (with/without short enums) agree on 44-byte sections and 860-byte header. Bit patterns and cross AArch64 -mgeneral-regs-only compilation passed.

boundaries: pinned source -> compatibility transform -> kernel external build -> matching modules
evidence: Baseline build failed in aoc_ramdump_regions.h and aoc_sidetone_eq_set; r3 correctly did not start after the failed baseline.
R4 unit gate caught incorrect test constants before any kernel source write; corrected against original C++ header (17 sections).
R5 full kernel/modules build passed with exit 0 in 76.72 seconds; R6 W=1 AoC module build also passed.
R6 final complete build exit 0, exact transformed-source checks passed, artifact SHA-256 checks passed; no phone boot performed.
Local touch/AoC diff passed checkpatch --strict with 0 errors, 0 warnings and 0 checks.
limitations: Compilation does not prove AoC firmware compatibility, sound, sensors, or voice calls.
exit_gate: Pass actual-source layout and bit-copy tests and full kernel/modules compilation before image preparation.
